column1: # Friendly names for registrable domains, used by the traffic page.
# Keys must be the registrable domain (the last two labels, with the public
# suffixes the collector knows about), not a host name: "youtube.com", never
# "www.youtube.com".  Anything not listed here is displayed as its bare
# registrable domain, which is what the upstream gateway does for unknown
# applications too.  Edit freely; the file is read on every sampling round.
